verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers alerting, incident response, provisioning/GitOps for configs, and trace-metric correlation (exemplars), but nothing describes Grafana's deploy/release annotation or change-tracking feature that lets developers overlay deploy markers on dashboards to correlate with regressions. missing for 10: evidence of annotations API or deploy-marker feature, evidence of linking specific deploy/config-change events to metric regressions, any customer/community example of using this for correlation.
